pair_note: Observed predecessor completed-work duration and observed boundary; valid for utilization evidence.

decision.reason: The closed 61s/594s pair yields 9.31% utilization. Sensitivity at the same observed idle shows large utilization gains from longer safe useful-work duration. No evidence shows the ~600s comparator unsafe; scheduler jitter remains diagnostic only.

measurement_guard.rule: work_end_time must be an observed completed-work timestamp at or before the state write; active_work_sec must represent completed useful work only
measurement_guard.purpose: prevent projected durations from being misclassified as runtime-frontier evidence
